segments.title: Beardless Case Cold Open & Headlines
segments.notes: Pepito delivers sign-on; Case reveals accidental clean-shave, fields chat reactions and correspondent interruptions (Wet Mitchell, Jeb, Crum variants); covers State Department freedom.gov portal, bone-smashing influencer Clevicular, R. Kelly isolation, Bad Bunny film, German theater incident, Olympic dog, Sonic 4 casting, Kurt Cobain homicide declaration.

segments.title: Beard vs. No Beard Debate
segments.notes: Munch (pro-beard) and Crum (anti-beard) debate facial hair; Crum announces legal trial next week with defense firm Twyche & At, funded by hype train goal; references to hell/DMV assistant manager past; Newt Museum confusion; chat votes no-beard winner.

segments.title: Crum's Call-In Circle: Pals on Trial
segments.notes: Crum hosts call-in segment claiming everyone is pals; chatters appear as avatars (elephant, wolf, bots); Crum denies memory of death/hell, requests hang-in-there poster; multiple vote-outs; ends with technical difficulties.

segments.title: Chinese Robot Spectacle & Kendall Home Check
segments.notes: Case watches viral video of Chinese humanoid robots dancing at Crypto Arena; Kendall arrives home, reacts to beardless Case; Asian Case filter bit with Filipino jokes (Staten Island discovery); mutual roasting; Case plugs Friday stream.

segments.title: Raid to Static Slate
segments.notes: Case wraps, promotes Static Slate (Danny playing Poppy Playtime), confirms Friday return, secret stream sign-off.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchors beardless after accidental shave; fields correspondent chaos, debates, call-ins, and robot video; plugs Friday stream and Valentine's week.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Delivers cold-open sign-on; set hype train goal that funded Crum's legal defense fund.

characters.name: Crum (Leonard Crum)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Anti-beard debater; announces legal trial next week with firm Twyche & At; hosts call-in circle denying hell/Join the Wall memories.

characters.name: Munch (Ralph Munchcut)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Pro-beard debater; references Crum's hell DMV past; mocks Crum's memory loss; claims chat vote manipulation.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Calls in then arrives home; dislikes beardless Case; participates in Asian Case bit with Filipino jokes.

characters.name: Wet Mitchell
characters.notes: correspondent. Appears as female Crum variant; mukbang history; spars with Crum over chin/jawline.

characters.name: Jeb Nogget
characters.notes: recurring. Brief workshop appearance; rushes in without glasses; claims natural hairlessness.

characters.name: Hype Train
characters.notes: recurring. Derails during sub goal; freestyle raps about legal defense fund; claims to be from hell.

characters.name: Peter Gibbon
characters.notes: news stowaway. Referenced as still in walls; not seen on camera.

characters.name: Liliana
characters.notes: desk partner. Referenced as MIA; Case wishes she were accessible.

episode_summary: Case Blackwell broadcasts beardless after a grooming accident, triggering a network-wide facial hair crisis that derails the News desk into a Munch & Crum beard debate and a Crum-hosted call-in circle where he denies his own canonical death and hell tenure. Pepito's hype train goal inadvertently funds Crum's upcoming legal defense. The broadcast closes with a Chinese robotics showcase, Kendall's homecoming roast, and an Asian Case filter bit before raiding Static Slate.
